name: mem_consolidate
description: Atomically consolidate at least two live observations owned by expected_project. Preview by default without writes; inspect the returned plan, then repeat the exact arguments with confirm=true and its opaque fingerprint. Drift refuses without writes and returns a new preview. Never automatically confirm a replacement plan or retry an uncertain write. Session/scope are inherited; this guarantees local atomicity, not remote visibility.

confirm.description: Default false: preview only; true requires the preview fingerprint

expected_project.description: Explicit expected canonical owner of every source, not a target-project override

fingerprint.description: Opaque preview fingerprint, required when confirm=true

ids_to_delete.description: At least two distinct positive integer observation IDs, each at most 9007199254740991

new_content.description: Non-empty summary; store appends the provenance footer

type.description: Optional survivor type; defaults to newest source
